name: spielebox
description: Unofficial: search the WIENXTRA-Spielebox board game library in Vienna, check availability, and send reservation requests. Not affiliated with WIENXTRA.
long_description: Unofficial, independent tool for the online catalog of the WIENXTRA-Spielebox (opac.wienxtra.at), Austria's largest board game library. Not affiliated with, endorsed or authorised by WIENXTRA. Search ~9000 games with filters for players, age and play time, see the availability of each copy, collect games on a reservation list and send it as a reservation request. You submit every reservation yourself on the Spielebox's official order form; the extension stores no personal data.
